notes: Fiscal years are based on FICO’s reporting period ending Sep 30; historical years used are FY2023–FY2025 and forecast years are FY2026–FY2030. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0000814547/000081454725000030/fico-20250930.htm))
EBIT is modeled as GAAP operating income from the consolidated statements of income. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0000814547/000081454725000030/fico-20250930.htm))

D&A is taken from the consolidated statement of cash flows line item “Depreciation and amortization” (in thousands). ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0000814547/000081454725000030/fico-20250930.htm))

Capex is modeled as (Purchases of property and equipment + Capitalized internal-use software costs). This is a modeling choice to align with the cash-flow presentation; see historical capex components. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0000814547/000081454725000030/fico-20250930.htm))

NWC construction is: (Accounts receivable, net + Prepaid expenses and other current assets) − (Accounts payable + Accrued compensation and employee benefits + Other accrued liabilities + Deferred revenue). Cash and marketable securities are excluded; “current maturities on debt” is excluded from NWC. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0000814547/000081454725000030/fico-20250930.htm))

Tax rate (0.20) is a base-case effective-tax assumption consistent with historical effective tax rates (provision for income taxes vs. income before taxes). FY2025 effective tax rate is ~0.188; FY2024 is ~0.201; FY2023 is ~0.225. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0000814547/000081454725000030/fico-20250930.htm))
WACC is an assumption (0.085) and is not explicitly disclosed in the filings in this package; it should be reviewed/overridden by the DCF pipeline if you use a standardized WACC build method.
Terminal method is gordon_growth, so terminal_exit_ebitda_multiple is set to null because it is not used.
Current price uses the latest available trade from the pricing tool (most recent trade time shown as Mar 20, 2026 UTC), so presentation as_of_date is set to 2026-03-20.

NOL balance is from FY2025 Form 10-K and is stated as “approximately $1.3 million”; NOL utilization percent is an assumption (0.80) for modeling purposes. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0000814547/000081454725000030/fico-20250930.htm))

Comps: AlphaSpread peer multiples are used due to availability. EV/NTM revenue is approximated using AlphaSpread EV/S; EV/NTM EBITDA uses AlphaSpread EV/EBITDA as presented; P/E uses AlphaSpread peer P/E. ([alphaspread.com](https://www.alphaspread.com/security/nyse/fico/relative-valuation/enterprise-value-to-ebitda))

Base-case FY2026 revenue growth (0.18) is calibrated to align with management’s FY2026 guidance revenue of $2.35B cited in the Q1 FY2026 earnings release. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/814547/000081454726000010/exhibit991erq12026.htm))

catalysts: Continued execution in Scores growth drivers (including utilization and unit price dynamics) could accelerate revenue and cash generation.
Software recurring revenue momentum (platform ARR and retention) could lift consolidated margins.
Portfolio and capital allocation actions (repurchases / financing mix) can materially affect equity value per share.
company_overview: FICO is a global analytics software leader, providing predictive analytics and decisioning solutions to help customers improve risk management, credit access, and operational decisions.
Scores revenue is generated primarily through customer agreements with major consumer reporting agencies and through consumer offerings (myFICO.com).
Software revenue includes on-premises and SaaS analytics and digital decisioning technology, with ongoing recurring revenue components.
current_context: In Q1 fiscal 2026 (ended Dec. 31, 2025), FICO reported revenues of $512.0 million (+16% y/y) and GAAP EPS of $6.61.
FICO reiterated fiscal 2026 guidance: revenues of $2.35 billion and GAAP net income of $795 million (GAAP EPS $33.47).
Most recently completed fiscal year (FY2025) reported total revenues of $1.990869 billion and operating income of $924.850 million.
investment_highlights: Base-case revenue growth is anchored to management’s FY2026 revenue guidance, with a gradual taper thereafter.
High operating profitability is sustained in the base case via stable EBIT margin assumptions consistent with recent FY2023–FY2025 trends.
Capital intensity remains comparatively low in this model (capex modeled as a % of sales) reflecting FICO’s asset-light profile.
key_risks: Credit-cycle and transaction-volume sensitivity could pressure Scores demand and timing of license revenue.
Regulatory and policy changes affecting consumer credit reporting and use of credit scores could impact customer demand and monetization.
Integration/technology execution risk around software platform expansion and capitalized development assumptions.
